title: Tomato Soup for Dinner
setting: A bright family kitchen in a two-floor house.

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: Aiko, a young girl with short black hair wearing a red T-shirt

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan, a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt

sentences.en: Aiko and Dan have a conversation about dinner.
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with short black hair wearing a red T-shirt and Dan, a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt talk in a sunny kitchen in the afternoon.

sentences.en: That afternoon, Dan brings tomatoes up from the garden.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，丹从花园里拿上来一些番茄。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt carries a basket of red tomatoes up the garden steps into the kitchen.

sentences.en: The tomato soup slowly becomes thick.
sentences.scene_prompt: A pot of red tomato soup bubbles on the stove, Aiko, a young girl with short black hair wearing a red T-shirt stirring it.

sentences.en: Some soup falls on her red T-shirt.
sentences.zh: 一些汤洒在了她的红T恤上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A drop of soup falls from a spoon onto Aiko, a young girl with short black hair wearing a red T-shirt's T-shirt, and she looks down.

sentences.en: It is not bad; the colour is the same.
sentences.zh: 这不要紧，颜色是一样的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with short black hair wearing a red T-shirt smiles and shows her T-shirt; the soup stain is the same red as the shirt.

sentences.en: But she runs upstairs for a clean shirt.
sentences.zh: 但她还是跑上楼去换一件干净的衬衫。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with short black hair wearing a red T-shirt runs up the stairs of the house.

sentences.en: Dan fills two big bowls with hot soup.
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt fills two big bowls with red tomato soup at the table.

sentences.en: In the end, Aiko is sure it is delicious.
sentences.zh: 最后，爱子确信这汤很好喝。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young girl with short black hair wearing a red T-shirt in a clean shirt tastes the soup and smiles happily, Dan, a tall man with brown hair and a blue shirt watching.
